title: Sequencing: exhibit installation
bodyMd:
Five exhibits are installed in successive work periods. Each takes one period and is installed once.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Bronze, Clay, Glass, Stone, Wood.

- Glass must be immediately followed by Bronze.
- Wood must precede Clay.
- Bronze and Stone must not occupy consecutive positions.
